info.name: TutorHub API Tests
info.description: Runnable, self-asserting API suite built from the real routes. Each request has pm.test assertions; tokens/ids are captured automatically. Run: node run-newman.js (API + MongoDB running). The last folder holds requests that document defects and are EXPECTED to fail until fixed.

exec: pm.test('generic message', () => pm.expect(j.message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('description updated', () => pm.expect(j.description).to.eql('Updated via Postman test'));

item.name: [Defect Issue-1] Approve beyond maxStudents — SHOULD be 409, currently 200

exec: // Class has maxStudents=2 and 2 approved students. A 3rd approval must be refused.
pm.test('Pure Maths series present', () => pm.expect(j).to.have.property('Pure Maths'));
pm.test('fee records created for approved students', () => pm.expect(j.createdCount).to.be.above(0));
